info.title: SJewls Admin & Staff Portal API
info.description: API endpoints for the SJewls Admin Web Portal — Staff Authentication, Password Recovery, Staff User Management, Customer Management with Full Unmasked NIC, Store Branch Management, Jewellery Category & Plan Management, Jewellery Enrolment Lifecycle, and Chitu Monthly Lucky Draw Management.

post.description: Authenticates a staff member or Super Admin using their username/email and password. Returns a JWT bearer token and user profile.
Invalidates current staff sessions by updating security stamp and logs the logout event.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated staff member's profile, roles, and branch assignments. Enforces active status and security stamp validity.

post.description: Sends an expiring single-use password reset link to the staff member's email if an active account exists. Returns the same message regardless of whether the email exists.
Validates the single-use reset token and password policy, updates the password hash, invalidates the token and previous sessions, and logs the change.

get.description: Retrieves all store branches with assigned staff counts and customer counts. Supports keyword search and active/inactive status filtering.

post.description: Creates a new branch. Branch Code must be unique. Requires Super Admin permissions.

get.description: Retrieves detailed branch information including staff assignments and customer statistics.

put.description: Updates store branch details (Name, Address, City, Country, Currency, Timezone, Active status). Requires Super Admin permissions.

delete.description: Deletes a branch that has no assigned customers, staff members, or active plans. Requires Super Admin permissions.

patch.description: Toggles branch active status. Deactivating the only remaining active branch is blocked. Requires Super Admin permissions.

get.summary: List Chitu Plans with Database-Derived Live Card Metrics
get.description: Retrieves active, inactive, or all Chitu plans with real-time slot payment coverage and overdue raffle indicators.

post.description: Creates a new Cash or Gold Chitu savings plan with scheduled raffle rounds and calculated end date.

get.summary: Get Detailed Chitu Plan Information and Schedule
get.description: Fetches plan details including the full raffle round schedule and winner history.

put.description: Allows safe descriptive updates to Chitu plan name, description, or status.

post.summary: Preview Slot Assignment and Required Initial Payment
post.description: Calculates next sequential slot numbers, required round coverage, and prepayment breakdowns before confirming assignment.

post.summary: Assign Chitu Slots with Atomic Initial Payment
post.description: Atomically creates sequentially numbered slots, marks initial scheduled instalments as paid, and posts confirmed payment to the ledger.

get.summary: Get Customer's Payable Slots in a Chitu Plan
get.description: Retrieves active slots owned by the customer with next unpaid instalments and confirmed paid totals.

post.summary: Preview Payment Allocation Across Selected Slots
post.description: Applies oldest-unpaid-first allocation per slot and verifies whole multiple amounts before confirmation.
Atomically records confirmed cash, card, or bank transfer payments and posts allocations to oldest unpaid instalments.

get.summary: Get Slots Eligible for a Physical Raffle Round
get.description: Retrieves active slots that have fully paid every instalment from Round 1 through the specified raffle round.

post.summary: Record the Physical Raffle Draw Winner for a Round
post.description: Records the winning slot, stops future payment obligations, calculates entitlement (Price x Months), and flags advance excess for admin review.

get.summary: Get Customer and Slot Roster for a Chitu Plan
get.description: Displays slot-by-slot roster with paid/unpaid status for a selected round, paid-through month, total paid, and winner status.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 50).

get.summary: List Customers with Pagination and Filters
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of customers. Supports search by name, phone, email, or NIC, as well as filtering by branch and account status. Super Admins can access all branches; Branch staff are strictly restricted to their assigned branch.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 50).

post.description: Allows authorized branch staff or Super Admin to create a customer. Normalizes inputs, prevents duplicate NICs and contacts, and keeps contacts unverified until customer verifies via OTP.

get.description: Calculates customer counts (Total, Active, Inactive) across matching branch and search criteria prior to pagination. Status filter is not applied so active and inactive counts remain independent.
Provides aggregated counts for total slots, total customers, active investments, closed accounts, inactive accounts, and pending accounts according to staff branch permissions.

Retrieves detailed profile information for an authorized customer, including date of birth, unmasked NIC for authorized staff, verification flags, and list of associated Chitu and Jewellery savings slots. Secrets, OTPs, and password hashes are never exposed.

patch.description: Enables authorized staff to deactivate or reactivate a customer account within permitted branch scope. Deactivation requires a reason and immediately revokes all sessions/refresh tokens.

get.description: Retrieves all jewellery plan enrolments for an authorized customer, including historical, completed, and closed enrolments with full payment and contribution history.

post.description: Records a branch gold rate in LKR per gram for calculations and customer quotes.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of jewellery categories. Super Admins view across branches or filter by branch; Branch Staff are isolated to their assigned branch.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 50).

post.description: Creates a new jewellery plan category (e.g., Gold Bars, Thali Kodi, Necklace). Prevents duplicate normalized category names within the same branch.

get.description: Retrieves detailed jewellery category information including associated plan counts.

put.description: Updates jewellery category name, description, visual image, and active status. Validates normalized name uniqueness.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an unused jewellery category. Rejects deletion if plans are associated, directing staff to deactivate instead.

patch.description: Toggles active operational status of a jewellery category. Deactivation hides it from new plan creation without affecting existing enrolments or payments.

post.description: Uploads a category image (PNG, JPG, WEBP, max 2MB) directly to Supabase Storage and returns the public CDN URL.

post.summary: Preview Plan Assignment Eligibility and Repeat Status
post.description: Checks customer and plan eligibility, verifies repeat enrolment count, and provides read-only target grams, premium, and offered durations.

post.summary: Assign Jewellery Savings Plan to Customer by Staff
post.description: Creates a new active enrolment for an authorized customer without initial payment. Enforces read-only plan target grams, offered durations, branch eligibility, and repeat enrolment confirmation.

get.description: Retrieves detailed snapshot terms, saved and remaining grams, progress, and contributions for a specific enrolment.

post.description: Calculates authoritative Buy Amount or Buy Gram breakdown using live 24K gold rate and enrolment premium snapshot without altering database state.

post.summary: Record In-Store Cash Received for Enrolment
post.description: Authoritatively records cash received in store on today's branch date. Applies live gold rate, credits gold grams atomically, updates balances, and marks enrolment Completed if target is reached.

get.description: Retrieves all confirmed payments and gold contributions for a specific enrolment.

get.summary: List Jewellery Plan Payments across permitted branches
get.description: Retrieves confirmed online, confirmed staff cash, and genuine pending payments across jewellery enrolments within the staff's branch scope. Includes stable instalment numbering derived from full enrolment history, pre-pagination monetary and gold aggregates, branch timezone date filtering, and customer navigation links.

Lists jewellery enrolments whose agreed duration ended below target gold grams without completed settlement. Includes customers who never paid, calculates remaining grams and confirmed money paid, and provides reminder eligibility.

get.summary: Get Authorised Reminder Context for Jewellery Enrolment
get.description: Retrieves verified customer and enrolment context, inactive/incomplete reminder reason, deadline, last payment date, and available notification channels for staff draft review.

post.summary: Dispatch Reminder Notification for Jewellery Enrolment
post.description: Validates staff branch authorization and dispatches a draft reminder notification through the selected supported channels (In-App, Email, SMS). Push notifications report honestly as unsupported.

get.summary: List Jewellery Plans with Card Progress
get.description: Retrieves a paginated card grid of jewellery plans with database-derived overall gold progress, lifetime counts/totals, date filtering (fromDate/toDate for joining date and confirmed payment date), category filtering, search, and status. Branch Staff are strictly isolated to their branch; Super Admins can filter across branches.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Optional category filter. When provided, returns only active plans belonging to this category.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 50).

post.description: Creates a new jewellery savings plan with selected category, custom or default duration options (in whole months), authoritative target gold grams, and start date. Validates category branch ownership.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific jewellery plan, including duration options, target gold grams, start date, and enrolment progress.

put.description: Updates plan metadata, category, target gold grams, start date, and offered durations. Existing customer enrolments retain their agreed snapshot terms (target grams, selected duration, joining date, and deadline).

patch.description: Transitions plan operational status between Active/Scheduled and Deactivated. Deactivating blocks new enrolments while allowing existing enrolled customers to continue contributing until their duration deadline. Reopening makes the plan available again once the start date arrives. Plan deletion is prohibited.

get.summary: View Enrolled Customers for Jewellery Plan
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of customers enrolled in the specified jewellery plan, showing joining date, chosen duration, deadline, enrolment target grams, confirmed currency paid, net accumulated grams, remaining balance, individual progress percentage, and contribution history.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 50).

post.description: Uploads a jewellery product image (PNG, JPG, WEBP, max 5MB) to Supabase Storage and returns the public CDN URL.

Calculates gold contribution conversion using the current applicable 24K branch rate. Supports conversion by grams (grams × rate = payable money) and by money (money ÷ rate = credited grams) with strict 4-decimal gram precision and remainder checks.

get.description: Retrieves a list of staff accounts. Super Admins view all staff; Branch Admins view staff within their assigned branch. Password hashes are never returned.

post.description: Allows Super Admin to provision a new staff or admin user, assigning their role and branch. Validates email, phone, and password policy, and prevents duplicates.

patch.description: Allows authorized administrators to activate or deactivate a staff member. Super Admin can manage all staff and admins (preventing deactivation of the last Super Admin). Staff cannot deactivate themselves. Sessions are immediately invalidated upon deactivation.

get.description: Retrieves all currently active branches for customer registration, store location selection, and mobile lookups.

Bearer.description: Enter your JWT Bearer token (e.g., Bearer eyJhbGci...)
